response.sql:
WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.arcref AS project_reference,
    p.fundflux AS funding_source,
    AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  WHERE s.gbsize / s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_group_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT
  g.project_reference,
  g.funding_source,
  g.rate,
  g.rate - b.avg_group_rate AS excess
FROM group_rates AS g
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE g.rate > b.avg_group_rate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The benchmark is the unweighted average of the qualifying group rates; groups with no nonmissing scan ratios are excluded because they have no rate to average.
